tbesh_html:
1) to be high, be exalted
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be high, lofty, tall
1a2) to be exalted
1a3) to be lofty
1a3a) to be lofty (of Jehovah's ways-good sense)
1a3b) to be haughty, be arrogant (bad sense)
1b) (Hiphil) to make high, exalt

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to soar, i.e. be lofty; figuratively, to be haughty
strongs_1890.kjv_def: exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.
